goal: Make temp git fixture repos in the Python tests deterministic by disabling git's detached background maintenance (gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false), so TemporaryDirectory cleanup can no longer race it and fail the SQL migration guards job with Errno 39, without relaxing, skipping or retrying any guard or assertion.
prohibited_actions: No shared database reads or writes, no production or preview apply, no migration files, no change to any guard, assertion, skip or retry, no fabricated reviews.
assumptions: The Errno 39 cleanup failures come from the detached git maintenance process that git 2.47+ spawns after each commit, not from an unwaited foreground subprocess.
stop_conditions: The fix would need to change a guard, an assertion, or the gate code under test.
